versions.changelog:
v0.1.1 Changelog

- Clarified that all research and content generation use only publicly available Internet sources.
- Updated SKILL.md to require each generated skill begin with a disclaimer stating “not the person themself”, and to include a limitations/statement after each response.
- Refined research phase language to focus solely on positive, verifiable professional achievements; removed references to filtering “negative noise/rumors”.
- Modified directory instructions to use the current workspace for skill generation.
- Updated workflow and documentation for greater transparency and stricter compliance.

- Initial release of fuxi-skill, an expert-level cognitive operating system generator.
- Automates extraction of the most valuable, positive expert thinking frameworks from target individuals.
- Employs a structured four-phase workflow: initialization, parallel research (with six positive dimensions), distillation, and SKILL.md generation.
- Filters out negative and unverified content, focusing on core philosophies, decisions, expression, societal value, authenticity, and growth.
- Delivers a ready-to-use skill directory, core SKILL.md, comprehensive research documentation, and usage examples.
